scope: Selected copies of existing result records plus explicitly derived start summaries. No scientific source, model, fit, seed, parameter, or saved paper number is changed.

original_record_copy_policy.numeric_fields: preserved exactly as JSON values with type-aware verification
original_record_copy_policy.source_bytes: preserved byte-for-byte when there are no absolute-path replacements
original_record_copy_policy.machine_paths: absolute private paths replaced by original-project-relative paths or explicit external-location placeholders

source_archives.archive_container_note: Contains one extra duplicate nested part005 ZIP; every expected record is validated separately.

derived_field_dictionary.record_role: current is a final current start; archived_precontinuation is a historical unqualified start before continuation and is never counted as another current start.
derived_field_dictionary.dataset_id: Synthetic task dataset_id, or real-data task path including its window.
derived_field_dictionary.seed: Original unsigned 64-bit random seed represented as a decimal string to avoid loss in JSON consumers using binary64 numbers.
derived_field_dictionary.em_status: Qualification at the EM endpoint only; coordinate refinement can qualify an EM-unqualified start.
derived_field_dictionary.final_status: Qualification of the source record after its recorded coordinate work.
derived_field_dictionary.selected_for_current_fit: True only for the selected current start. Historical archived records are always false.
derived_field_dictionary.history: Counts, minimum recorded increments, and stage-connection arithmetic derived from saved arrays; not full trajectories.
derived_field_dictionary.history.em_min_adjacent_increment: Minimum difference of adjacent saved EM iterates; the unsaved pre-first-iteration objective is not included.
derived_field_dictionary.history.coordinate_min_increment_includi: Minimum change from the coordinate initial objective through all saved coordinate endpoints.
derived_field_dictionary.history.em_to_coordinate_objective_gap: Coordinate initial objective minus saved EM objective; tiny floating-point differences may reflect summation order.
derived_field_dictionary.original_record: Source archive and member path of the full start record.

omitted_material: Raw event/spike arrays and CRCNS recordings
Pickle files and legacy outer realdata outputs
Duplicate real-data selected fit records already represented in paper/data/realdata_fits.json
